_comment: Copy to brief.config.json (gitignored). Claude Code fills in allowedTools during setup. List ONLY read-only tools: search, list, get, read. Never send, post, reply, react, create, update, delete or draft tools. blockedTools: every OTHER tool those services offer (anything that can change something), so they stay denied even if your own Claude Code settings pre-approve them. Tool names depend on how each service is connected in your Claude Code; check with /mcp.
